name: Pixel RPG
tagline: a 16-bit dialog box: Press Start 2P typed word by word, hot pink and gold on indigo, hard cuts and held frames.

motion.direction: Pixel RPG. A 16-bit dialog box: captions typed word by word in Press Start 2P (small — 44 px — the font is wide) on a dark box with a 3 px pink `ter` border; poster lines SHORT (1–3 words, 70–110 px), typed with a cursor; numbers as gold `counter`s that count like score (+120 XP), a `stamp` LEVEL UP / GAME OVER, `chips` as menu options, a `chapterCard` as STAGE 2. Everything moves in held frames (stop-motion), hard cuts, cyan `goldd` for the cursor and highlights. Keep lines tiny: this font fills the width fast.
